sentences.english: Winter Clothing Festival was almost here.

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽在家里帮妈妈准备纸衣和祭品。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì zài jiālǐ bāng māma zhǔnbèi zhǐyī hé jìpǐn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili were at home helping their mother prepare paper clothes and offerings.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈对他们说：“寒衣节我们要给去世的爷爷送寒衣。天气冷了，爷爷在那边也需要暖和衣服。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma duì tāmen shuō: "Hányījié wǒmen yào gěi qùshì de yéye sòng hányī. Tiānqì lěng le, yéye zài nàbiān yě xūyào nuǎnhuo yīfu."
sentences.english: Mom said to them, "For the Winter Clothing Festival, we need to send winter clothes to Grandpa, who has passed away. It's getting cold, and Grandpa over there also needs warm clothes."

sentences.hanzi: 小明问：“妈妈，爷爷能收到我们做的纸衣吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng wèn: "Māma, yéye néng shōudào wǒmen zuò de zhǐyī ma?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming asked, "Mom, can Grandpa receive the paper clothes we make?"

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈笑着说：“这是我们的心意。爷爷会知道我们想他。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma xiàozhe shuō: "Zhè shì wǒmen de xīnyì. Yéye huì zhīdào wǒmen xiǎng tā."
sentences.english: Mom said with a smile, "This is our way of showing we care. Grandpa will know that we miss him."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“我也很想爷爷。他以前常常给我买糖吃。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ yě hěn xiǎng yéye. Tā yǐqián chángcháng gěi wǒ mǎi táng chī."
sentences.english: Lili said, "I really miss Grandpa too. He used to buy me candy often."

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“我记得爷爷喜欢穿蓝色的衣服。我们做一件蓝色的纸衣吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ jìde yéye xǐhuan chuān lánsè de yīfu. Wǒmen zuò yī jiàn lánsè de zhǐyī ba."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "I remember Grandpa liked to wear blue clothes. Let's make a blue paper outfit."

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈点点头：“好，你们真有心。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma diǎndian tóu: "Hǎo, nǐmen zhēn yǒu xīn."
sentences.english: Mom nodded: "Good, you are very thoughtful."

sentences.hanzi: 他们一起剪纸、折衣服，还准备了爷爷爱吃的水果和点心。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yīqǐ jiǎn zhǐ, zhé yīfu, hái zhǔnbèi le yéye ài chī de shuǐguǒ hé diǎnxīn.
sentences.english: They cut paper, folded clothes, and also prepared Grandpa's favorite fruits and snacks.

sentences.hanzi: 小明一边做一边说：“爷爷，天冷了，这件衣服给您穿。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng yībiān zuò yībiān shuō: "Yéye, tiān lěng le, zhè jiàn yīfu gěi nín chuān."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said as he worked, "Grandpa, it's getting cold. This outfit is for you to wear."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽也说：“爷爷，我们都很好，您别担心。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì yě shuō: "Yéye, wǒmen dōu hěn hǎo, nín bié dānxīn."
sentences.english: Lili also said, "Grandpa, we are all fine. Don't worry."

sentences.pinyin: Māma tīng zhe, yǎnjing yǒudiǎn hóng.
sentences.english: Mom listened, and her eyes turned a little red.

sentences.hanzi: 做完以后，他们把纸衣和祭品放在桌子上。
sentences.pinyin: Zuò wán yǐhòu, tāmen bǎ zhǐyī hé jìpǐn fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
sentences.english: After they finished, they placed the paper clothes and offerings on the table.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈点上香，一家人一起对爷爷的照片说：“爷爷，我们想您。请您在那边也好好照顾自己。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma diǎn shàng xiāng, yī jiā rén yīqǐ duì yéye de zhàopiàn shuō: "Yéye, wǒmen xiǎng nín. Qǐng nín zài nàbiān yě hǎohǎo zhàogù zìjǐ."
sentences.english: Mom lit the incense, and the whole family said together to Grandpa's photo, "Grandpa, we miss you. Please take good care of yourself over there."

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽认真地鞠了躬。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì rènzhēn de jū le gōng.

sentences.hanzi: 妈妈摸摸他们的头说：“你们的思念和孝心，爷爷一定能感觉到。”
sentences.pinyin: Māma mōmo tāmen de tóu shuō: "Nǐmen de sīniàn hé xiàoxīn, yéye yīdìng néng gǎnjué dào."
sentences.english: Mom touched their heads and said, "Grandpa will surely feel your longing and filial love."

sentences.hanzi: 那天晚上，小明躺在床上想：爷爷虽然不在我们身边，但我们的爱和想念会一直陪着他。
sentences.pinyin: Nà tiān wǎnshang, Xiǎomíng tǎng zài chuáng shang xiǎng: Yéye suīrán bù zài wǒmen shēnbiān, dàn wǒmen de ài hé xiǎngniàn huì yīzhí péi zhe tā.
sentences.english: That night, Xiaoming lay in bed thinking: Although Grandpa is no longer with us, our love and longing will always stay with him.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽走进房间说：“哥哥，以后每年寒衣节我们都要帮妈妈准备。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì zǒu jìn fángjiān shuō: "Gēge, yǐhòu měi nián Hányījié wǒmen dōu yào bāng māma zhǔnbèi."
sentences.english: Lili walked into the room and said, "Brother, from now on, every Winter Clothing Festival, we should help Mom prepare."

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“好，我们一起记住爷爷，也要对妈妈更好。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Hǎo, wǒmen yīqǐ jìzhù yéye, yě yào duì māma gèng hǎo."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Okay, let's remember Grandpa together, and be even nicer to Mom."
